description: Create a task (card) in a column on a 'todo' board. Generates and returns a stable task id. `column_id` must reference an existing column (see `list_tasks`). `description` is free-form prose stored on the card; `priority` is one of 'H' | 'M' | 'L' (omit for none); `due_date` is an ISO 8601 date string; `assignee` is free text (name / initials / email). `sort` is a float ordering key within the column (ascending), defaulting to 0.

access_key.description: 8-character lowercase alphanumeric board access key when the board is locked (legacy 6-character lowercase alphanumeric keys are also accepted). Equivalent to setting the `X-Board-Key` HTTP header on the JSON-RPC POST. Omit for unlocked boards. Obtain via POST /api/boards/<id>/lock.

done.description: Whether the task is completed (checked off). Defaults to false.

priority.description: High / Medium / Low. Omit for none.

sort.description: Float ordering key within the column. Defaults to 0.

name: create_task
title: Create Task
